title: McConnell invites Kirkpatrick to Senate interviews and the Fugal briefing
summary: Kurt McConnell tells of McConnell invites Kirkpatrick to Senate interviews and the Fugal briefing, about 2017-2022 at Senate Armed Services Committee hearing room, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Senate Armed Services Committee hearing room

tellings.quote: I invited him with some regularity to sit in on our interviews of uh of Navy pilots and and some of the scientific figures.

plain: Kirk McConnell, a staff member for the US Senate, says that between about 2017 and 2022 he regularly invited a man named Sean Kirkpatrick to sit in on interviews his team held with Navy pilots and some scientists. He says these took place in the hearing room of the Senate Armed Services Committee, the Senate committee that oversees the military, and he also tells of a briefing connected to a man named Brandon Fugal. He tells it as an insider showing how seriously Congress was gathering first-hand accounts of unexplained sightings.
